module: COS temporary bucket and OBS proxy storage identity

findings.scenario: Temporary COS SaveBytes returned an HTTPS URL rejected by resource registration, while read/delete only targeted the primary bucket.
findings.fix: Persist canonical cos:// paths and resolve both primary and configured temporary bucket consistently for reads, signing, copy and deletion.

findings.scenario: With OBS proxyDomain, SaveFile/SaveBytes/CopyFile returned proxy URLs that resource registration could not identify.
findings.fix: Persist obs:// identity while keeping proxy URL generation at serving time; parser accepts canonical identity with proxy enabled.

evidence.command: go test ./internal/application/service/file -run 'Test(COSTemporaryBytesUseResolvableResourcePaths|OBSProxyBytesKeepProviderStorageIdentity)' with baseline source overlay
evidence.result: both failed on canonical provider-path assertions

limitations: Real COS/S3 SDK request handling with in-memory HTTP transport; no cloud account or external service contacted.
Shared resource ownership fixes are a separate in-progress group.
